title: sonde show -f json
description: A run: what it amounts to and its findings, each cut to what to change and where (`show -f json`). `--all` adds every operation and each finding's operations and fixes whole; `--errors` adds the failed operations; `--requests` adds the requests (with `--errors`, the failed ones).

operationsTotal.description: How many operations the run has.

waiting.description: How long the program waited on the store.

waitingMs.description: Time with any request in flight.

byKind.description: Each kind of request: its requests, errors, latencies, waiting and its share, cost (the one table of kinds).

whatIf.description: The run with every finding's fix; null when no finding names what its fix saves (none, or none that can be counted).

findings.description: With `--all`: the findings whole, in the order of their diagnoses (`diagnoses[].findings` are places in it): every operation each is about, each SDK's fix.

verify.description: The command that records the program again, in the folder it ran in (`run.cwd`), as it was recorded (its store, policy and TLS), to see a fix work: then `since.findings[].state` says fixed, less, more, new or open. Null for a run that is no program's (an import, a replay).

trials.description: The run's last trial, scenario by scenario, each with its history (`sonde run --trial`).

program.description: The program, as its runs are grouped (empty when the run is no run of a program, with `--since`).

previous.description: The earlier run compared, by path: the program's run before, or the run `--since` names.

findings.description: Each finding of either run, where it stands: fixed first, then less, new, more, open; then each kind of failure whose count moved (`obs.errors|500 InternalError`); a trial's finding against the program's trial before.

identity.description: The same finding across runs: its kind and what it is about ([fix loop](../cli.md#the-fix-loop)). One about its bucket with objects in several names each, sorted (`obs.small|data,logs`; before 33.0, `obs.small|/`).

state.description: Judged by its count alone (`counts`), never by a share of the run: fixed: gone at any threshold; less and more: still there at any threshold, its count fallen or grown; new: none of it in the run before, at any threshold; open: as much in both. A count under 100 is exact; from 100, within a hundredth of the count before (rounded down) is as much (33.0: before, exact at any size).

was.description: As it read in the run before, when it reads otherwise now (less, more).

counts.description: How much of it each run had (times listed, requests throttled or failed), the run before first.

predicted.description: What acting on it was predicted to save, as the plan said it in the run it was found in (its time from the plan's ranking): beside `savedRequests`, when there is one.

savedText.description: Display text, not stable: its own requests saved, beside the time it was predicted to save (`40 fewer requests (predicted 1.5 s less)`). Absent when it saved no request and predicted no time. The run's time is said once, in the change (`wallMs`, `withinNoise`).

savedRequests.description: The requests of its own asks the later run did not send, measured between the runs (fixed, less). Never the run's time: that is the run's (`change.wallMs`), said once.

empty.description: True: the run recorded no request (nothing reached sonde); it is not compared.

failed.description: The exit code of a run that failed: not compared.

unsaved.description: Why the program's kept findings were not read or written, when so (the runs folder's `.index.jsonl` could not be written): the run is compared all the same.

since.description: The run against its program's run before it, or against the run `--since` names, as `show` says it under "since …": `program`, `previous`, `change` (the figures), `findings` (each with its `state`: fixed, less, more, new, open; a trial's finding against the program's trial before: fixed, new, open); or `failed` (the exit code of a run that failed: not compared), or `empty` (true: the run recorded no request, nothing reached sonde; not compared). Null when nothing was compared (a program's first run: its findings, all new, are the plan), and for a run that is no run of a program with no `--since`.

operations.description: With `--all`: every operation, in order; with `--errors`: those that failed.

requests.description: With `--requests`: every request, as the file has it.

time.description: Where the run's time went (the time account a reading opens with); null for an imported log or a replay (no program's own time), or a run that sent nothing.

diagnoses.description: The plan: findings that share a root cause are one diagnosis, with one saving and one fix (its headline finding's). What is wrong first (a warning that saves nothing: a lost update, a trial that broke), then those that save the most time, then money, then requests; the rest after: the first is the next step. Each finding is in one diagnosis.

cost.description: What the run cost at the endpoint's prices (docs/cli.md#cost): its requests, its bytes out, and apart what it left stored a month.

amount.description: The run's money: `requests`, and `transfer.amount` when `transfer.egress` is `charged`.

egress.description: `charged`: read from outside the store's region (the endpoint's `egress = true`); `free`: read in it (`egress = false`) or a store with no egress fee; `unknown`: not said, so not in `amount` (`amount` here is what it would be if read from outside the region).

amount.description: The bytes at the egress price (0 when `free`).

storage.description: What the run left stored, a month (not in `amount`).

bytes.description: Bytes it wrote and did not delete.

versioned.description: A write's answer said the bucket keeps versions.

noncurrent.description: Versions its overwrites and deletes made noncurrent there.

noncurrentBytes.description: The bytes of those whose size the run saw.

noncurrentPerMonth.description: What they cost a month until a lifecycle rule expires them.

git.description: The commit the program's code was at.

waitingMs.description: Time with one of these in flight.

text.description: Display text, not stable: in English.

operations.description: The operations it is about (their places in the run's operations), every one.

operationsTotal.description: How many operations it is about.

identity.description: The same finding across runs: what `[check] expect` names. One about its bucket with objects in several names each, sorted (`obs.small|data,logs`; before 33.0, `obs.small|/`, and a read written back the bucket of the key written back the most).

expected.description: Why the project keeps it on purpose (`[check] expect` in the run's sonde.toml): leave it.

kind.description: What kind of finding it is, as `identity` begins (docs/cli.md#findings).

savesMs.description: Time of the run acting on it alone saves, in ms: the run without its requests, its waiting reckoned again (requests one after another: their waiting less the same at once). Of requests whose bytes are read still, in fewer requests (`obs.smallreads`), their round trips alone: each one's part of the waiting up to its first byte (33.0: before, the time their bodies took to arrive too). Absent for a run whose times are not known.

savesBytes.description: Bytes it would not read out of the store.

savesCost.description: What the requests and bytes it would save cost, in the run's currency (times `month.times`: a month); bytes count only when `cost.transfer.egress` is `charged`.

fixes.description: How to fix it, each SDK's: the engine's setting where its requests are an engine's (SlateDB, DuckDB, rclone, …), else the fix for each SDK, or a store's setting.

callers.description: Where its requests were sent from, most first (three at most): a place in the program's code when the run named callers; for an imported log, who sent them (an IAM principal).

phrase.description: A sentence as a key and its arguments: the app says it in the reader's language.

key.description: The phrase's key in the app's locales (en, zh).

sonde.description: The sonde that wrote the file (its version).

command.description: The command sonde ran, when it ran one.

cwd.description: The folder the command ran in.

trialOf.description: The clean run a trial is of (its file name).

wholeSeconds.description: Request times are to the second (an imported log).

seconds.description: From the first request's start to the last one's end.

errorCodes.description: Each error's status or code and its count.

whatIf.description: The run as it is and as it would be with every finding's fix: each a pair.

bytesOut.description: The bytes read out of the store.

waitingMs.description: Null when the run's times cannot say it (an imported log's, to the second).

trial.description: A trial's verdict, a row of its table (docs/trials.md): why it is not `survived`, where and what to change are a finding of the run's (`findings[]`, kind `trial`).

times.description: The attempts in a row it failed at each request, when it was asked to press harder than once (`slowdown:3`).

standing.description: `refused`: the recording policy refused what the program did under the scenario (and not in its clean run): not judged, never `broke`.

exit.description: The program's exit code under the scenario.

cleanExit.description: Its exit code in the clean run.

faults.description: Requests sonde failed in the store's place (bodies cut and races lost among them).

retried.description: Of the faults, the ones the program sent again.

notRetryable.description: Of the faults, the ones no retry is owed for: a 404, a 403, a 501, a request the clean run itself never got an answer for, and the races `yielded`. Neither retried nor dropped. Absent when 0.

readAgain.description: Failed reads of a key the clean run reads more than once, answered later: a retry or the program's next round, not told apart. Absent when 0.

droppedReads.description: Failed reads it never sent again.

droppedWrites.description: Failed writes it never sent again.

lostWrites.description: Of the dropped writes, the ones the store made all the same: their answer was lost, and the program did not ask again. Absent when 0.

checked.description: Writes whose answer was lost, not sent again, and whose key the program then read: it asked the store, which had made them. Neither retried nor dropped. Absent when 0.

reuploaded.description: Uploads whose completion the store made, its answer lost, that the program started again from their first part. Absent when 0.

held.description: Requests a stall held before their first byte. Absent when 0.

waited.description: Of `held`, the ones the program waited out instead of cutting short and sending again. Absent when 0.

stale.description: Keys this run wrote that a listing left out. Absent when 0.

relisted.description: Of `stale`, the ones a later listing showed. Absent when 0.

missed.description: Of `stale`, the ones the program then never read as its clean run did. Absent when 0.

rewrote.description: Of `stale`, the ones it wrote again. Absent when 0.

cut.description: Downloads whose body sonde cut short. Absent when 0.

resumed.description: Of `cut`, the ones made good by a read from the cut on. Absent when 0.

reread.description: Of `cut`, the ones made good by a read of the whole again. Absent when 0.

races.description: Conditional writes answered 412 though they would have won. Absent when 0.

readBack.description: Of `races`, the ones whose write the store had made and which the program read back and did not write again. Absent when 0.

yielded.description: Of `races`, creates (`If-None-Match: *`) of a key that is no table's log (a marker, a lock) that the program took as made and did not write over. Among `notRetryable`. Absent when 0.

fenced.description: Present (true) when a SlateDB writer that lost its race stopped and wrote nothing more: fenced, as the format means it. Its exit is not held against it.

attempts.description: The most attempts at one request: its failures in a row, and the attempt that followed them.

backoffMs.description: The waits before a retry, in milliseconds: shortest, median, longest. Only waits within one sender; absent when there is none.

jitter.description: Whether the waits before one attempt number differ enough to be jittered. Absent with fewer than four waits before the same attempt, and of waits too short to tell (`jitterTooShort`).

jitterTooShort.description: Present (true) when the waits are too short to say whether they are jittered.

delayed.description: Requests the scenario delayed (and did not fail). Absent when 0.

wallMs.description: How long the run under the scenario took, in milliseconds: the command's own time when `sonde run` measured it, else from the first request to the last answer.

cleanWallMs.description: How long the clean run took, in milliseconds.

leftUploads.description: Multipart uploads left unfinished, beyond the clean run's.

wroteTwice.description: Writes the store made twice: made, their answer lost, made again. Not deletes, nor creates sent with `If-None-Match: *`.

run.description: The trial's own run: its file's name in the clean run's `trials/` folder.

history.description: The scenario's verdicts for the program, oldest first, up to this one (kept in the runs folder's `.index.jsonl`).

operation.description: An operation: requests that belong together.

shape.description: The shape of the operation: what its requests are together (a request alone, a multipart upload, a retry, lookups that found nothing, a listing over pages, a step of a storage format). `kind` is a request's S3 call only.

format.description: The storage format a step is of (`iceberg`, `delta`, …).

detail.description: A failure's status and S3 code.

record.description: One request: a line of the run file (docs/dev/run-format.md).

kind.description: The request's kind: the S3 call (`GetObject`, `Unknown`).

status.description: The HTTP status; null when no answer came.

errorBody.description: The error's body, up to 64 KiB.

requestBody.description: A control request's body (DeleteObjects, a lifecycle rule).

injected.description: The fault scenario that answered or changed it (a trial).

month.description: The run's money a month: an imported log's at the rate of its span (`from`: `log`), a program's run times `[program] runs-per-month` (`from`: `runs`). Null when neither says one.

times.description: How many of this run a month is: a finding's `savesCost` times this is its saving a month.

cost.description: A month's cost at that rate.

change.description: Two runs, the earlier and this one: each figure a pair (earlier, this run).

objects.description: The objects each run asked of (each key, each prefix listed, once): what its workload is judged by.

groups.description: With `--since` or `--all`: kinds of request, the largest change first.

sameProgram.description: Both are runs of one program: their findings compare.

waitingKnown.description: Whether both runs' waiting is known: false when either's times are to the second (an imported log's); `waitingMs` then says nothing.

commandChanged.description: Display text, not stable: how the command changed between two runs of one program (a named one's), `--limit 200 → 20`. Present only then: fixed, less and more carry no `savedRequests` or `savedText`.

workloadChanged.description: Display text, not stable: how much the workload changed between two runs of one program with the same command (`objects 120 → 402, 3.4×`), by the objects each asked of: grown by half or more, or shrunk by a third or more below what the first run's findings fixed or less did away with (small files written as fewer). Present only then: what moved is the workload's doing as much as a fix's, and fixed, less and more carry no `savedRequests` or `savedText`.

noiseMs.description: How much the program's wall time varies run to run, in ms: the band two of its runs differ within 19 times in 20, read from its runs before the later one alike in command and findings (no fix between them, up to 5): 2.77 × their range over the range a sample of that many has (1.19 × the range of five, 1.35 of four, 1.64 of three, 2.46 of two); of two, never under a tenth of their time and 50 ms, of three never under half of that. Absent with fewer than two such runs (no band). (33.0: before, the largest move from one of them to the next.)

withinNoise.description: Present (true) when the run's wall time moved by `noiseMs` or less: what moved is not told from noise, run it again.

endpoints.description: The two runs' endpoints, when they differ: the same workload on two stores.

failed.description: The exit code of a run compared that failed (the later's, when both did): its findings are not compared, and `findings`, `resolved` and `appeared` are empty.

saving.description: Requests not sent, time not taken (ms) and money not spent (`cost`, in the run's currency).

timeAccount.description: Where a run's time went: the program's own (no request in flight), the round trips (a request in flight), and of those the bytes moving. Absent for an import, a replay, or a run with no command (`run --listen`): their idle time is no program's own.

wallMs.description: From the first request to the end of the last.

ownMs.description: With no request in flight: the program's own work.

waitingMs.description: With a request in flight, S3's (not `injectedMs`).

injectedMs.description: With only requests a trial's fault held or answered in flight: sonde's time, not S3's nor the program's. Absent when none.

transferMs.description: Of the waiting, the part spent moving bytes (after the first byte), when the store says when that came; else 0. Each request's part of the waiting (a moment's split among the requests then in flight) by the share of its own time after its first byte: never more than the waiting, nor than the time bytes moved in (33.0: before, weighed by the requests' times added up, which counts bodies moving at once once each).

most.description: What most of the time went to.

indicative.description: True: its times say little (the built-in demo store's).

diagnosis.description: Findings that share a root cause (at least half of each one's objects are its headline's, and the headline's theirs), as one change, with what an agent needs to make it: what (`text`, `kind`), where (`at`), the `fix`, what it saves. Requests one after another join the diagnosis that owns most of them.

id.description: The same diagnosis across runs: made of its findings' identities (`dx-` and a hash).

findings.description: With `--all`: its findings, as places in `findings`: the headline first (its text, callers and fix are the diagnosis's), its requests one after another (`serial`) last.

identities.description: Its findings' identities, in the same order.

serial.description: With `--all`: the place in `findings` of its requests one after another (`obs.serial`), when they joined it (said in `also`).

savesMs.description: Time of the run acting on it saves: its findings' requests taken out together, each request's part of the waiting off (a moment's waiting split among the requests then in flight), never their sum.

savesCost.description: What it saves in the run's currency (times `month.times`: a month).

atOnce.description: Its requests one after another (`obs.serial`), counted: `requests`, those its other findings leave; sent `concurrency` at once, those save `savesMs`: the part of the finding's saving that is theirs, by their part of its requests' waiting (33.0: before, what all of its requests saved, those taken away too).

kind.description: Its headline finding's kind, as `identities[0]` begins ([kinds](../cli.md#findings)): `obs.small`, `obs.headget`, … `trial`.

text.description: Display text, not stable: its headline finding, what it is and what to change.

also.description: Display text, not stable: its other findings, each said, and its requests one after another as the rest of the change (`and send the other 87 requests 8 at once`).

expected.description: Its findings the project keeps on purpose (`[check] expect` in sonde.toml), by identity, each with why: leave them.

at.description: Where its headline's requests were sent from, most first: `file` and `line` (relative to `run.cwd`), `function`, `code` (the line itself). Edit there.

fix.description: The change to make, for the SDK that sent its requests (an engine's: its `setting`). Absent when none is known.

place.description: As the program or the log said it: `etl.py:25 process`, `arn:aws:iam::1:role/etl`.

file.description: The file, relative to the folder the program ran in (`run.cwd`), when `place` is a place in code.

requests.description: How many of its requests were sent from there.

code.description: The line of code itself, when the file is there to read.

sdk.description: `python`, `java`, `go`, `js`, `rust` (object_store), `rust-aws` (the AWS SDK for Rust), or `config` for a store's or an engine's setting.

code.description: The change, its first line a comment that says it. An SDK's has placeholders (`b` the bucket, `k` the key); an engine's names the real ones.

setting.description: The engine's setting it changes: the one edit to make.

engine.description: The engine or tool: `SlateDB DbReader`, `DuckDB`, `rclone`, `Hadoop s3a`, …

value.description: The value to give it, as the engine reads it.

where.description: `file:line` (relative to `run.cwd`) where the program's folder sets it now; absent when sonde finds none.
